## Broadsheet

Made to be seen. Big pages with authority and impact.

- 350 mm × 500 mm | 380 mm × 578 mm
- 2-40 pages
- 5 paper options

## Tabloid

The classic newspaper size. Our most popular product.

- 289 mm × 380 mm
- 4-64 pages
- 5 paper options

## Midi

The sweet spot between a magazine and a newspaper.

- 220 mm × 310 mm
- 16-64 pages
- 2 paper options

## Mini

Small size, big energy. A newspaper with zine spirit.

- 170 mm × 250 mm
- 16-64 pages
- 4 paper options
